_help: The circuits to choose from in the lobby: road courses, the whole lap as straights (metres) and turns (degrees, left positive, right negative; radius in metres; optional banking in degrees), the same as Stock Cars' road courses. It must turn 360° and end where it started. The first and last straights are the main straight either side of the start/finish line, where the pit lane runs: keep both at 200 m or more. 'width' is the track wall to wall in metres; 'time' is day, dusk or night; 'scenery' is countryside, desert, harbour or city.

circuits.name: Valley Ring
circuits.about: Fast and flowing through the hills: sweepers both ways, a long back straight and a hairpin. 2.8 km.

circuits.name: Harbour Streets
circuits.about: Through the city at sunset: right-angle corners between the walls, no room for mistakes. 2.0 km.
